title: Checkout release 2.14 changes
text: Release 2.14 commit b7a19f2 unified promotion validation. PromotionValidator comparison changed from now > expiresAt to now >= expiresAt. Canary only tested non-boundary quotes. No requirement change recorded.

title: Inventory reservation contention / release_notes
text: 3.2 release 7d12abc moved transactions to controller layer; internal reservation worker still invokes service directly. Load validation used only sequential requests.

title: Tenant cache isolation / release_notes
text: 5.8 commit 91abcee introduced shared Redis profile cache. Per-tenant process-local cache was removed. Release tests used globally unique subjects, masking key collisions.
